title: Standing Ceiling by Membership Tier on New Tailwise Pharmacy Diet Orders
content:
*Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus benefit schedule, pharmacy supply.*

The days' supply per fill of a new Tailwise Pharmacy prescription diet order placed for a pet whose diet another household pet already takes is no more than the standing ceiling. The standing ceiling follows the customer's Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus membership tier and its status, as the membership record shows them.

| Membership tier | Status | Standing ceiling |
|---|---|---|
| Tailwise Plus Annual or Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | active | the class's maximum days' supply per fill |
| Tailwise Plus Monthly or Pals Rewards VIP | active | 45 days: the 30-day new-order days' supply plus 15 days |
| Pals Rewards Member or Pals Rewards Insider | any | 30 days |
| any tier | past due, pending downgrade or closed | 30 days |
| no membership | | 30 days |

## Points of judgement

- Tier and status are read together: a Tailwise Plus Annual membership past due stands at 30 days.
- The ceiling is a limit, not a target: it caps the days' supply per fill and never raises it.
